verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents a Cloud Billing REST API for managing billing programmatically, and a Budget API that tracks actual spend against planned spend with Pub/Sub notifications. That gives some programmatic access to cost data, but nothing in the evidence shows the core of the story: queryable cost line items, scheduled exports, or resource-level detail. Missing for 10: evidence of scheduled cost/billing exports (e.g., to a data warehouse), resource-level cost granularity, an API for querying detailed cost line items, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, cost data is queryable — a billing/cost API and scheduled exports with resource-level granularity, not just a dashboard screenshot

citations.quote: Allows developers to manage billing for their Google Cloud Platform projects programmatically.
A budget enables you to track your actual Google Cloud spend against your planned spend.
